block.bloodandbones.beheader.tooltip.beh: PH: Zombies, skeletons, creepers and piglins sometimes leave their skull whole. A wither skeleton's rarely does.
block.bloodandbones.beheader.tooltip.sum: PH: A spinning saw that takes heads off in one stroke. Drive it with a shaft from below.
block.bloodandbones.bleeding_rack.toolti: PH: A hanging carcass drains faster than a lying one. An Encased Fan blowing across the body speeds it up.
PH: Pipes can pull blood from its sides and bottom, never fill it. When it is full the carcass stops draining.
PH: A carcass drained of its blood keeps longer before it rots.
PH: A drip tray that catches blood. Hang a carcass on a Shackle Hook above it, or lay one on it, and the blood drains in.
block.bloodandbones.deglover.tooltip.beh: PH: A few turns and the whole hide comes away, wool and all. Faster shafts strip faster.
block.bloodandbones.deglover.tooltip.sum: PH: Spiked rollers that strip the hide off a carcass. Drive it with a shaft from below.
block.bloodandbones.guillotine.tooltip.b: PH: Cuts the limb nearest the blade off any carcass over it. It never takes the head: that is the Beheader's job.
block.bloodandbones.guillotine.tooltip.s: PH: A heavy blade that takes a limb off in one stroke. Drive it with a shaft from below.
block.bloodandbones.mangler.tooltip.beha: PH: Works whatever carcass lies on it or hangs over it, up to two blocks up. Limbs come off first, then every piece is ground.
PH: What it makes waits inside: take it with an empty hand, or pull it out with a funnel, chute or hopper. When full it stops.
block.bloodandbones.mangler.tooltip.summ: PH: Tears carcasses apart and grinds the pieces into meat, bone, offal and fat. Drive it with a shaft from below.
block.bloodandbones.shackle_hook.tooltip: PH: A hanging carcass keeps swinging and can be worked on from all sides.
PH: Click the hook again, or with an empty hand, to let it down.
PH: Hangs a carcass. Drag one up to it and click the hook with the Meat Hook to hang it by the limb you are holding.
bloodandbones.jei.bleeding_rack.1: PH: Put the Bleeding Rack under a Shackle Hook (up to 8 blocks below) and hang a carcass: its blood drips into the tray. A carcass lying still on the rack drains too, more slowly.
bloodandbones.jei.bleeding_rack.2: PH: A cow gives about a bucket. Fans across the body drain it up to four times faster. Pipe the blood out from the sides or bottom; a bled carcass rots slower.
bloodandbones.jei.butchery.1: PH: Cut a limb off with the Cleaver, then keep cutting the loose piece: it breaks down into meat, bone, and from the body offal and fat.
bloodandbones.jei.butchery.2: PH: Bigger pieces give more. Fresh meat is whole; half-rotten meat gives half; badly rotten meat turns to rotten flesh.
bloodandbones.jei.cleaver.1: PH: The Cleaver takes a carcass apart. Right-click a limb three times to cut through the joint; the limb comes free as its own piece.
bloodandbones.jei.cleaver.2: PH: Severed limbs can still be hooked and dragged on their own. The body cannot be cut through, only its limbs.
bloodandbones.jei.flensing_knife.1: PH: The Flensing Knife takes the hide off a carcass. Right-click any part of it four times; the hide drops and the carcass shows bare meat.
bloodandbones.jei.flensing_knife.2: PH: Skin before you butcher: a piece cut down with its hide still on loses the hide. An unsheared sheep gives its wool too. Rot spoils hides.
bloodandbones.jei.machines.1: PH: The Mangler, Guillotine, Beheader and Deglover work carcasses lying on them or hanging over them. Each takes a shaft from below; the faster it turns, the faster it works.
bloodandbones.jei.machines.2: PH: Guillotine: limbs off. Beheader: heads off, sometimes a skull. Deglover: hides off. Mangler: everything, down to meat. Outputs are taken out with funnels or an empty hand.
bloodandbones.jei.meat_hook.1: PH: The Meat Hook is how carcasses enter the pipeline. Kill an animal with it and the whole body stays behind as a physics carcass instead of dropping loot.
bloodandbones.jei.meat_hook.2: PH: Right-click a limb to hook it and drag the carcass behind you. Heavier animals slow you down more. Right-click again to let go.
bloodandbones.jei.shackle_hook.1: PH: Mount the Shackle Hook under a ceiling or on a wall. Drag a carcass close and click the hook with the Meat Hook to hang it.
bloodandbones.jei.shackle_hook.2: PH: Hanging carcasses stay ragdolls, so they swing, and will be routable along chain conveyors.
item.bloodandbones.carcass_piece.tooltip: PH: Shift-right-click a head, a leg or a whole small animal with an empty hand to pick it up.
PH: A piece still attached to a body has to be cut off first.
PH: A piece of carcass light enough to carry. Right-click the ground to put it back down as a body.
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.behav: PH: The body itself cannot be cut through.
PH: A severed limb is its own piece: hook it, drag it, hang it.
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.summa: PH: Right-click a limb of a carcass to cut into it. Three cuts sever the joint and the limb comes off; three more on a loose piece butcher it.
item.bloodandbones.flensing_knife.toolti: PH: Skin before butchering, or the hide is lost.
PH: A rotting carcass gives a poorer hide, a rotten one none.
PH: Right-click a carcass to skin it. A few strokes take the whole hide off.
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.beh: PH: Dragging slows you down. Heavier animals slow you more.
PH: Where you hook matters: the limb you grab is the one that gets pulled.
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.sum: PH: Kill an animal with this and it leaves a whole carcass instead of loot. Right-click a carcass to drag it, right-click again to let go.
